title: Randomized space is contained in bounded-error space
statement: For every function $s : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, $\mathrm{RSPACE}(s) \subseteq \mathrm{BPSPACE}(s)$. Here $\mathrm{RSPACE}(s)$ uses finite randomized machines with space bounded by a constant multiple of $s$, acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members, and no accepting branches on nonmembers; $\mathrm{BPSPACE}(s)$ uses such a space bound and outputs the correct membership bit with probability at least $2/3$ on every input.
